objective: Define the CLI that converts a local ImageNet validation directory or approved scoped subset plus labels into the manifest consumed by reference inference and accuracy calculation.

tool.hf_streaming_example_command: HF_TOKEN=... artifacts/mobile_vit/venv/bin/python src/tools/mobile_vit_imagenet_manifest.py --hf-dataset ILSVRC/imagenet-1k --hf-split validation --hf-output-dir artifacts/mobile_vit/apple_mobilevit_small/hf_imagenet_val --dataset-scope imagenet_validation --output artifacts/mobile_vit/apple_mobilevit_small/imagenet_manifest.json --limit 50000

input_contract.labels: text file with '<image_filename> <integer_class_id>' or comma-separated equivalent
input_contract.hf_dataset: optional Hugging Face datasets streaming source, e.g. ILSVRC/imagenet-1k validation, using HF_TOKEN when required

covered: manifest generation from images and labels
explicit one-based to zero-based label conversion
HF streaming manifest materialization with fake loader

blocked_by: no local ImageNet validation image directory or approved scoped subset
unauthenticated HF ILSVRC/imagenet-1k access is gated
